name: Keyboard Bridge Wars! 🧱
desc:
Welcome to Keyboard Bridge Wars!

🅰️ Collect keyboard blocks and place them!
💥 Shoot your enemies' bridges to destroy them!
💰 Earn cash to buy better weapons and upgrades!
🏆 Reach the trophy first to win!

👥 Play with friends, unlock cool weapons, and level up!

🎧 ASMR vibes included
✨ Smooth movement, satisfying keyboard clicks, creamy visuals, and relaxing candy sounds for a perfect mix of speed & chill

Tags: Speed, Keyboard, Candy, Chocolate, ASMR, Obby, Escape, Parkour, Multiplayer, Racing, Competitive, Satisfying, Relaxing, Physics, Bridge, Battles, Shooter, Nuke, Challenge, Speedrun
